| [Background Workers and Outboxes](parts/01-core-back/05-workers.md) | `core.workers` | `partial` | high | 2026-11-07 | The trigger is installed by the deploy provisioner, not by a Prisma migration, so an externally managed audit database must run the provisioner DDL.; The inbound webhook route verifies and processes synchronously; `InboundInboxWorker` is wired but has no producer, so it is effectively idle.; Checkout and POS SSE streams poll the database every 2-3 seconds instead of subscribing to the transition bus.; `RetentionWorker` is disabled by default, does not purge AML/KYB/reporting evidence, and does not purge the ledger by design.; `OutboxRelayWorker` projects `attempt.transitioned` in batches; `ledger.entry_posted` and the other declared topics are no-ops (and `ledger.entry_posted` is no longer emitted by default), so there is no ledger-driven CQRS.; `ExpirySweeperWorker`, `PollWorker`, `InboundInboxWorker`, `OutboxNotificationWorker` and `PeriodicScreeningWorker` select `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` OUTSIDE a transaction (autocommit), so the row locks are released immediately and two nodes can claim the same rows (duplicate gateway inquiries / sends). Open (GAP-DB-02).; `KybExpiryWorker` re-reads the first `batchSize` ACTIVE merchants every tick (no cursor), so later merchants are never evaluated. Open (GAP-DB-03).; `PollWorker` releases a slot for `FAILED`/`CANCELLED` but not for `EXPIRED`/`BLOCKED`, unlike the expiry sweeper's terminal release path.; `JoinRequestExpiryWorker` uses raw updates without audit rows or merchant notifications.; Per-worker health and metrics are not exposed; `/health` reports only durable-queue depth/age.; `WORKER_CONCURRENCY` exists in env validation but is not used by the worker runtime.; Singleton leader election uses a session-level advisory lock on one dedicated connection. RESOLVED 2026-11-07: the endpoint is now `LEADER_ELECTION_DATABASE_URL` (a PgBouncer `pgw_session` alias with `pool_mode=session`, or direct PostgreSQL); core refuses to boot when `PGBOUNCER_ENABLED=true` and the URL is missing or still the transaction-pooled `DATABASE_URL`, and a boot-time probe plus per-tick backend-PID/`pg_locks` ownership checks fail closed. `InboundInboxWorker` also has a durable claim lease (`claimed_at`/`claimed_by`), so even a brief leadership overlap cannot process a webhook twice. `claimLeaseSeconds` (default 120) must exceed the longest per-row processing time. FIXED 2026-11-08: the claim statement used one untyped parameter for `claimed_at` (`timestamptz`) and `updated_at` (`timestamp`), which PostgreSQL rejects with 42P08, so the worker failed every tick; both uses are now explicitly cast and `test/inbound-inbox-claim-pg.test.ts` prepares the real statement. |
